Install omarchy-hyprland-titlebars on Omarchy

Titlebars for Omarchy's floating workspaces

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omarchy-hyprland-titlebars
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.2.2-2:
    pacman -Qi omarchy-hyprland-titlebars

Open and use omarchy-hyprland-titlebars

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omarchy-hyprland-titlebars on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omarchy-hyprland-titlebars. The download is 186.9 KB and it takes 430.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omarchy-hyprland-titlebars free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed BSD-3-Clause, MIT.

How do I uninstall omarchy-hyprland-titlebars?

Run omarchy pkg drop omarchy-hyprland-titlebars. It removes the package from your system.

What does omarchy-hyprland-titlebars depend on?

The package declares 6 dependencies: glibc, libgcc, libstdc++, hyprlang, hyprutils, hyprland. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omarchy-hyprland-titlebars in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omarchy-hyprland-titlebars (version 0.2.2-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-hyprland-titlebars. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
